rb1_cooc_time_decay.sql: WITH E AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 180), L AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, a FROM (SELECT e.user_id, e.item_id, {A} - e.t AS a, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.user_id ORDER BY e.t DESC, e.item_id) AS p FROM ev e JOIN users s ON s.user_id = e.user_id) WHERE p <= 20), S AS (SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM L), CI AS (SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM cand), N AS (SELECT item_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM E GROUP BY item_id), CO AS (SELECT x.item_id AS i, y.item_id AS j, COUNT(*) AS k FROM E x JOIN S ON S.item_id = x.item_id JOIN E y ON y.user_id = x.user_id AND y.item_id <> x.item_id JOIN CI ON CI.item_id = y.item_id GROUP BY x.item_id, y.item_id), SIM AS (SELECT CO.i, CO.j, CO.k / SQRT(ni.n * nj.n) AS sv FROM CO JOIN N ni ON ni.item_id = CO.i JOIN N nj ON nj.item_id = CO.j), G AS (SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, SUM(SIM.sv * EXP(-L.a / 14.0)) AS td, MIN(L.a) AS ma FROM cand c JOIN L ON L.user_id = c.user_id JOIN SIM ON SIM.i = L.item_id AND SIM.j = c.item_id GROUP BY c.user_id, c.item_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, COALESCE(G.td, 0) AS ag_rb1_cooc_tdecay, COALESCE(G.ma, 1000) AS ag_rb1_cooc_min_age FROM cand c LEFT JOIN G ON G.user_id = c.user_id AND G.item_id = c.item_id

rb1_backward_transition.sql: WITH L AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM (SELECT e.user_id, e.item_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.user_id ORDER BY e.t DESC, e.item_id) AS p FROM ev e JOIN users s ON s.user_id = e.user_id) WHERE p <= 5), S AS (SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM L), CI AS (SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM cand), A1 AS (SELECT e.user_id AS v, e.item_id AS i, e.t AS ti FROM ev e JOIN S ON S.item_id = e.item_id WHERE e.t >= {A} - 180), NI AS (SELECT i, COUNT(*) AS ni FROM A1 GROUP BY i), BT AS (SELECT A1.i, e.item_id AS j, COUNT(*) AS k FROM A1 JOIN ev e ON e.user_id = A1.v JOIN CI ON CI.item_id = e.item_id WHERE e.t < A1.ti AND e.t >= A1.ti - 30 GROUP BY A1.i, e.item_id), G AS (SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, SUM(BT.k * 1.0 / NI.ni) AS sv FROM cand c JOIN L ON L.user_id = c.user_id JOIN BT ON BT.i = L.item_id AND BT.j = c.item_id JOIN NI ON NI.i = L.item_id GROUP BY c.user_id, c.item_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, COALESCE(G.sv, 0) AS ag_rb1_back_tr FROM cand c LEFT JOIN G ON G.user_id = c.user_id AND G.item_id = c.item_id

rb1_user_taste_spread.sql: WITH L AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, t FROM (SELECT e.user_id, e.item_id, e.t, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.user_id ORDER BY e.t DESC, e.item_id) AS p FROM ev e JOIN users s ON s.user_id = e.user_id) WHERE p <= 20), P30 AS (SELECT item_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 30 GROUP BY item_id), FI AS (SELECT item_id, MIN(t) AS ft FROM ev GROUP BY item_id) SELECT L.user_id, STDDEV_POP(LN(1 + COALESCE(P30.cnt, 0))) AS ag_rb1_pop_std, AVG(CASE WHEN L.t <= FI.ft + 14 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS ag_rb1_fresh_share FROM L JOIN FI ON FI.item_id = L.item_id LEFT JOIN P30 ON P30.item_id = L.item_id GROUP BY L.user_id

rb1_history_coherence.sql: WITH E AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 180), L AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, p FROM (SELECT e.user_id, e.item_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.user_id ORDER BY e.t DESC, e.item_id) AS p FROM ev e JOIN users s ON s.user_id = e.user_id) WHERE p <= 10), PR AS (SELECT l1.user_id, l1.item_id AS i, l2.item_id AS k FROM L l1 JOIN L l2 ON l2.user_id = l1.user_id AND l2.p = l1.p + 1), DP AS (SELECT DISTINCT i, k FROM PR), N AS (SELECT item_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM E GROUP BY item_id), CO AS (SELECT DP.i, DP.k, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM DP JOIN E x ON x.item_id = DP.i JOIN E y ON y.user_id = x.user_id AND y.item_id = DP.k GROUP BY DP.i, DP.k) SELECT PR.user_id, AVG(COALESCE(CO.cnt / SQRT(ni.n * nk.n), 0)) AS ag_rb1_hist_coherence FROM PR LEFT JOIN CO ON CO.i = PR.i AND CO.k = PR.k LEFT JOIN N ni ON ni.item_id = PR.i LEFT JOIN N nk ON nk.item_id = PR.k GROUP BY PR.user_id

rb2_active_share.sql: WITH n AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t >= {A} - 30 THEN user_id END) AS n30, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t >= {A} - 7 THEN user_id END) AS n7 FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 30), i AS (SELECT item_id, sum(CASE WHEN t >= {A} - 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS u30, sum(CASE WHEN t >= {A} - 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS u7 FROM ev GROUP BY item_id) SELECT i.item_id, 1000.0 * i.u30 / greatest(n.n30, 1) AS ag_rb2_share30, 1000.0 * i.u7 / greatest(n.n7, 1) AS ag_rb2_share7 FROM i CROSS JOIN n

rb2_leader_cf.sql: WITH l AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, t FROM (SELECT user_id, item_id, t, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY t DESC, item_id) AS rn FROM ev WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)) s WHERE rn <= 8 AND t >= {A} - 180), e AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, t FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 210 AND item_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM l)), ld AS (SELECT l.user_id AS u, e.user_id AS v, count(*) AS w, max(e.t) AS lt FROM l JOIN e ON e.item_id = l.item_id AND e.t < l.t AND e.t >= l.t - 30 GROUP BY l.user_id, e.user_id), ldr AS (SELECT u, v, w FROM (SELECT u, v, w, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY u ORDER BY w DESC, lt DESC, v) AS rk FROM ld) q WHERE rk <= 30), rec AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 30 AND user_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT v FROM ldr)), tw AS (SELECT u, sum(w) AS sw FROM ldr GROUP BY u), z AS (SELECT ldr.u, rec.item_id, sum(ldr.w) AS w, count(*) AS nl FROM ldr JOIN rec ON rec.user_id = ldr.v GROUP BY ldr.u, rec.item_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, COALESCE(z.w * 1.0 / tw.sw, 0) AS ag_rb2_leader_share, COALESCE(z.nl, 0) AS ag_rb2_leader_cnt FROM cand c LEFT JOIN z ON z.u = c.user_id AND z.item_id = c.item_id LEFT JOIN tw ON tw.u = c.user_id

rb2_profile_coherence.sql: WITH l AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM (SELECT user_id, item_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY t DESC, item_id) AS rn FROM ev WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)) s WHERE rn <= 5), e AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 180 AND item_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM l)), n AS (SELECT item_id, count(*) AS cnt FROM e GROUP BY item_id), pr AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.item_id AS i, b.item_id AS k FROM l a JOIN l b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.item_id < b.item_id), cc AS (SELECT pr.i, pr.k, count(*) AS c2 FROM pr JOIN e a ON a.item_id = pr.i JOIN e b ON b.user_id = a.user_id AND b.item_id = pr.k GROUP BY pr.i, pr.k), z AS (SELECT a.user_id, avg(COALESCE(cc.c2 / sqrt(na.cnt * nb.cnt), 0)) AS coh FROM l a JOIN l b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.item_id < b.item_id LEFT JOIN cc ON cc.i = a.item_id AND cc.k = b.item_id LEFT JOIN n na ON na.item_id = a.item_id LEFT JOIN n nb ON nb.item_id = b.item_id GROUP BY a.user_id) SELECT u.user_id, z.coh AS ag_rb2_coherence FROM users u LEFT JOIN z ON z.user_id = u.user_id

rb2_user_earliness.sql: WITH l AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, t FROM (SELECT user_id, item_id, t, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY t DESC, item_id) AS rn FROM ev WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)) s WHERE rn <= 20), d AS (SELECT item_id, t, count(*) AS c FROM ev WHERE item_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM l) GROUP BY item_id, t), q AS (SELECT item_id, t, sum(c) OVER (PARTITION BY item_id ORDER BY t) - c AS bf, sum(c) OVER (PARTITION BY item_id ORDER BY t RANGE BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS r30, sum(c) OVER (PARTITION BY item_id) AS tot FROM d), z AS (SELECT l.user_id, avg(q.bf * 1.0 / q.tot) AS ep, avg(ln(1 + q.bf)) AS er, avg(ln(1 + COALESCE(q.r30, 0))) AS pa FROM l JOIN q ON q.item_id = l.item_id AND q.t = l.t GROUP BY l.user_id) SELECT u.user_id, z.ep AS ag_rb2_early_pct, z.er AS ag_rb2_early_lnrank, z.pa AS ag_rb2_pop_at_adopt FROM users u LEFT JOIN z ON z.user_id = u.user_id

rb2_basket_context.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT user_id, t, count(*) AS k FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 90 GROUP BY user_id, t) SELECT e.item_id, avg(ln(b.k)) AS ag_rb2_basket_ln, avg(CASE WHEN b.k = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS ag_rb2_solo_sh FROM ev e JOIN b ON b.user_id = e.user_id AND b.t = e.t WHERE e.t >= {A} - 90 GROUP BY e.item_id

rb2_evergreen_cover.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT item_id, CAST(floor(({A} - 1 - t) / 30) AS INTEGER) AS b FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 360), f AS (SELECT item_id, min(t) AS ft FROM ev GROUP BY item_id), g AS (SELECT item_id, count(DISTINCT b) AS nb FROM x GROUP BY item_id) SELECT f.item_id, COALESCE(g.nb, 0) * 1.0 / least(12, CAST(floor(({A} - 1 - f.ft) / 30) AS INTEGER) + 1) AS ag_rb2_bucket_cover FROM f LEFT JOIN g ON g.item_id = f.item_id

rb2_basket_match.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT user_id, t, count(*) AS k FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 90 GROUP BY user_id, t), ib AS (SELECT e.item_id, avg(ln(b.k)) AS ik FROM ev e JOIN b ON b.user_id = e.user_id AND b.t = e.t WHERE e.t >= {A} - 90 AND e.item_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM cand) GROUP BY e.item_id), ub AS (SELECT user_id, avg(ln(k)) AS uk FROM (SELECT user_id, t, count(*) AS k FROM ev WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users) GROUP BY user_id, t) z GROUP BY user_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, ub.uk - ib.ik AS ag_rb2_basket_gap FROM cand c JOIN ub ON ub.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN ib ON ib.item_id = c.item_id

rb2_user_lastcycle_season.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT user_id, sum(CASE WHEN t >= {A} - 365 AND t < {A} - 335 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ly, count(*) AS tot, min(t) AS ft FROM ev WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users) GROUP BY user_id) SELECT user_id, CASE WHEN ft < {A} - 365 THEN ln(1 + ly) ELSE -1.0 END AS ag_rb2_ly_items, ly * 1.0 / tot AS ag_rb2_ly_share FROM x
